---
title: "Untitled"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

N <- 500

X <- runif(N,0,1)

Tau <- X + rnorm(N)

D <- sample(0:1, N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.9,0.1))

Y <- Tau*D

IPW <- ((D*Y/mean(D)) - ((1 - D)*Y/mean(1 - D)))

mean(IPW)
mean(Tau)

boxplot(Tau,IPW)

tibble(
  Tau,
  IPW
) |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = Tau,
      color = "True"
    )
  ) +
  geom_density() +
  geom_density(
    aes(
      x = IPW,
      color = "Signal"
    )
  )
```
